term.label: C_D_box_scaRNA_gene

definition.text: A gene that codes for scaRNA possessing a box C/D sequence motif, guiding the methylation of snRNAs.

comments: Added at the request of Steven Marygold. See GitHub Issue #519 (https://github.com/The-Sequence-Ontology/SO-Ontologies/issues/519).
